n-m-e2-s2-05.title: Sinokuthembela kangakanani koko sikufumene kwiitheyibhile ezimbini?
n-m-e2-s2-05.topic: Iitheyibhile neegrafu: oko iitheyibhile ezimbini zinokusixelela kona
n-m-e2-s2-05.goal: Qonda ukuba iitheyibhile ezimbini ezisondeza abantu abafanayo ngeendlela ezimbini zixela kuphela inani ngalinye ngokwahlukeneyo kwaye azixeli inani labantu abakhethe zombini, uze uhlele ukuba yeyiphi idatha eyongezelelweyo efunekayo ukufumanisa oko.
n-m-e2-s2-05.material:
Abafundi abangama-20 beKlasi 1, kwiBanga lesi-2 bahlolwa ngezinto ezi-2. Umntu ngamnye ukhethe isiqhamo esinye kuphela nombala omnye. Wonke umntu waphendula zombini izingqinisiso.
Isiqhamo esithandwayo: iapile 9, itangerine 6, isidiliya 5
Umbala othandwayo: obomvu 8, oluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka 7, ophuzi 5
UJia ujonga iitheyibhile ezimbini kwaye ufuna ukufumanisa ukuba bangaphi abafundi abathanda obomvu neapile.
